title: ED-Triage-Agent: A Framework for Human-AI Collaborative Emergency Triage

live_model.evidence: Sec 3.1: "we utilize GPT-4.1-nano, the most lightweight variant" for the patient-facing Intake Interview Agent; Sec 4.1: simulated patient/clinician agents in evaluation are also GPT-4.1-nano.

prompt.location: Sec. 3.4 (prompt engineering strategies described); no verbatim prompt text quoted
prompt.note: Agent prompts described at a high level (JSON schemas, role definitions); not printed.

claim.metric: none isolating gpt-4.1-nano (headline ESI accuracy is a whole-pipeline metric)

data.source: ESI Implementation Handbook v4 case studies (60 cases, licensed handbook); code at https://github.com/Karthick47v2/ED-Triage-Agent

notes: The reported ESI-classification accuracies (Tables 3-5) come from the whole multi-agent pipeline, dominated by GPT-4.1-mini (CRA/PAA/TCA/OA reasoning agents), which is not on the tracked still-callable list. GPT-4.1-nano is used only for the patient-facing intake agent (IIA) and as a simulated-patient/clinician generator in the evaluation harness; no standalone accuracy number is reported for its own extraction output.
